source: Number codes of the keyword arguments that the regional_d trees pass to effects of other owners (decision E1): zin_tritons_set_side side (the Pupor Ocean system of the shared Triton's Islands tree, docs/design/focus/shared_tritons_islands.json declares the same codes: chart 1, haven 2, none 3).
